title: JUST DANCE 2026 EDITION
description: JUST DANCE 2026 EDITION adds the 2026 song catalog to Ubisoft's current Just Dance platform. Players use motion controls to follow choreography, compete or cooperate locally, and access connected services where supported. The seller card is red and explicitly categorized as a Switch 2 listing, so this import follows the seller platform rule; however, Nintendo's official store lists the entitlement as Nintendo Switch software that can be used on Nintendo Switch 2 through compatibility.

description_ar: يضيف JUST DANCE 2026 EDITION مكتبة أغاني 2026 إلى منصة Just Dance الحالية من Ubisoft. يستخدم اللاعبون التحكم بالحركة لمتابعة الرقصات والمنافسة أو التعاون محليًا والوصول إلى الخدمات المتصلة عند توفرها. بطاقة البائع حمراء ومصنفة كعرض Switch 2، لذلك يتبع هذا الاستيراد قاعدة منصة البائع، مع ملاحظة أن متجر Nintendo الرسمي يعرض الاستحقاق كبرنامج Nintendo Switch يمكن تشغيله على Nintendo Switch 2 عبر التوافق.
nintendoNotes:
Seller screenshot classification: Nintendo Switch 2 (red seller card). Nintendo's official store lists JUST DANCE 2026 EDITION as Nintendo Switch software; this import keeps platform=switch2 solely to follow the seller-platform rule, while recording the official classification here. Product account variants and costs are based on the supplied seller screenshots; platform classification follows the seller-card rule requested for this import.

Offline selling price is selected within 5,000–25,000 IQD according to demand, supply, popularity, recency, perceived market value and, where relevant, supplier cost. It is not a fixed cost multiplier. Online pricing is market-based and may be higher.

Extraction rules used for this file: production images are verified game media, not seller/Taobao images. Front Box Cover is retail box-front artwork; Square Card is a separate square asset; Cover Image is page/key art; 3D Texture Source is high-resolution front cover art. Banner and Gallery media are separate verified artwork/screenshots. Device Performance contains one device object only. Offline selling prices are chosen within 5,000–25,000 IQD according to demand, supply, popularity, recency, perceived value and supplier cost; online prices remain market-based and may be higher.
